title: C^1 segment bound: |phi(x)-phi(y)|^2 <= |x-y|^2 * int_[0,1] |grad phi((1-t)y+tx)|^2 dt
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ, every C^1 function φ : ℝ^n → ℝ (Lean: ContDiff ℝ 1 φ on Rn n = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) and all x, y ∈ ℝ^n: ‖φ(x) − φ(y)‖ₑ² ≤ ‖x − y‖ₑ² · ∫⁻_{t ∈ [0,1]} ‖∇φ((1 − t)·y + t·x)‖ₑ² dt, an inequality in [0, ∞], where ∇φ is Mathlib's gradient φ and the t-integral is the lintegral over Icc 0 1 for Lebesgue measure.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : Rn n → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → ∀ x y : Rn n, ‖φ x - φ y‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ‖x - y‖ₑ ^ 2 * ∫⁻ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖gradient φ ((1 - t) • y + t • x)‖ₑ ^ 2
